targetTexts.1: “Surely there is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined.
targetTexts.2: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.
targetTexts.3: Man puts an end to the darkness; he probes the farthest recesses for ore in deepest darkness.
targetTexts.4: Far from human habitation he cuts a shaft in places forgotten by the foot of man. Far from men he dangles and sways.
targetTexts.5: Food may come from the earth, but from below it is transformed as by fire.
targetTexts.6: Its rocks are the source of sapphires, containing flecks of gold.
targetTexts.7: No bird of prey knows that path; no falcon’s eye has seen it.
targetTexts.8: Proud beasts have never trodden it; no lion has ever prowled over it.
targetTexts.9: The miner strikes the flint; he overturns mountains at their base.
targetTexts.10: He hews out channels in the rocks, and his eyes spot every treasure.
targetTexts.11: He stops up the sources of the streams to bring what is hidden to light.
targetTexts.12: But where can wisdom be found, and where does understanding dwell?
targetTexts.13: No man can know its value, nor is it found in the land of the living.
targetTexts.14: The ocean depths say, ‘It is not in me,’ while the sea declares, ‘It is not with me.’
targetTexts.15: It cannot be bought with gold, nor can its price be weighed out in silver.
targetTexts.16: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or sapphire.
targetTexts.17: Neither gold nor crystal can compare to it, nor jewels of fine gold be exchanged for it.
targetTexts.18: Coral and quartz are unworthy of mention; the price of wisdom is beyond rubies.
targetTexts.19: Topaz from Cush cannot compare to it, nor can it be valued in pure gold.
targetTexts.20: From where, then, does wisdom come, and where does understanding dwell?
targetTexts.21: It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing and concealed from the birds of the air.
targetTexts.22: Abaddon and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor about it.’
targetTexts.23: But God understands its way, and He knows its place.
targetTexts.24: For He looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens.
targetTexts.25: When God fixed the weight of the wind and measured out the waters,
targetTexts.26: when He set a limit for the rain and a path for the thunderbolt,
targetTexts.27: then He looked at wisdom and appraised it; He established it and searched it out.
targetTexts.28: And He said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’”
